status: FROZEN before any confirmatory run. Every confirmatory record carries the SHA-256 of this file and of experiments/run_r9.py; a record whose digests differ from the committed files is not confirmatory evidence.
question: What measurable benefit, if any, does CGC contribute to the R7 Elpis PyTorch architecture beyond a parameter-matched FFN, and does it survive computation and memory accounting?

hypotheses.H1: CGC-specific benefit: arm A has lower held-out bits/byte than the parameter-matched FFN arm C on code and on prose, and also lower than the multiply-add-matched FFN arm C_mac.
hypotheses.H2: CGC contributes over the smaller FFN-only architecture: arm A has lower held-out bits/byte than arm B on code and on prose.
hypotheses.D: Reliance diagnostic: held-out bits/byte of the trained arm A with every CGC gate forced to 0 at evaluation, minus arm A. Descriptive; never a trained replacement and never evidence of superiority.
hypotheses.predictions_of_the_claim_under_test: If CGC is useful in this architecture: A < C, A < C_mac and A < B on both domains (lower is better). Ties or C <= A falsify the claim at this scale.

corpus.rule: R7's corpus: src/ and research/elpis_torch/ (*.py, without upstream/) and docs/ (*.md) read from git at the revision; a file is held out when SHA-256 of its path is 0 mod 10

model.initialization: R0's rule: every parameter is a function of (seed, parameter name), so every parameter two arms share starts identical

A.purpose: CGC-positive reference: R7's PLE model (routed FFN + CGC experts)

B.purpose: trained control with CGC absent from training (the same FFN width, fewer parameters)

C.purpose: DECISIVE: the CGC replaced by FFN width at the closest total parameter count

D.intervention: every CGC gate set to 0 at evaluation (parameters and compute still counted)
D.purpose: model reliance on CGC; not a fair trained replacement

C_mac.purpose: the CGC replaced by FFN width at the closest per-token multiply-add count

A0.purpose: no-PLE factorial: CGC x PLE interaction

matching.computed_before_training: run_r9 accounting on the meta device (results/r9/accounting.json); widths fixed in this file before any confirmatory run
matching.C: ffn_hidden 123: total parameters -0.022% of A, active parameters per token -0.17%, per-expert parameters -0.27%, per-expert multiply-adds -2.64% (A counts the CGC's cubic terms)
matching.C_mac: ffn_hidden 126: per-expert multiply-adds -0.26% of A, total parameters +0.18%, active parameters per token +1.31%
matching.B: ffn_hidden 86 without CGC: total parameters -2.47%, active parameters per token -18.4% (deliberately unmatched)
matching.rule: a control is called matched only on the resource it is matched on; every residual mismatch is reported

training.batch_stream: R7's seeded epoch (document_batches, seed s: 1,432 full batches for this corpus) continued by a second seeded epoch (seed s + 1000) until exactly 1,500 batches; identical for every arm of a seed
training.optimizer: AdamW, betas (0.9, 0.95), weight decay 0.01 on matrices and 0 on vectors; PLE tables: SparseAdam at lr_multiplier x the learning rate, no decay
training.schedule: linear warmup, cosine decay to 0.1 x lr at step 1,500
training.intermediate_evaluations: held-out bits/byte at steps 250, 500, ..., 1,500 are recorded for the learning curve only; no decision, early stop or selection uses them

evaluation.metric: bits per byte (mean cross-entropy over valid targets / ln 2; one byte per target)

analysis.delta_justification: about 1.2% of R7's reference code loss (1.732) and more than twice the spread (max - min = 0.018) of R7's paired PLE-versus-capacity differences on code
analysis.paired_difference: bpb(X, seed) - bpb(A, seed), same seed, same data order, same shared initialization; positive means A is better

classes.A_BETTER: every seed's difference > 0 and the mean >= delta_min
classes.X_BETTER: every seed's difference < 0 and the mean <= -delta_min
classes.NOT_DISTINGUISHED: every other outcome (ties within delta_min, inconsistent signs)

primary_verdict.CGC_BENEFIT_QUALIFIED: A_BETTER against C on code and on prose AND A_BETTER against C_mac on code and on prose
primary_verdict.FFN_PREFERRED: C is X_BETTER on at least one domain and A is A_BETTER against C on no domain
primary_verdict.CGC_NOT_ESTABLISHED: every other complete outcome (ties, mixed domains, a win against C but not against C_mac)
primary_verdict.NONQUAL: a run of A, C or C_mac (any seed) not COMPLETED within its limit, a corpus digest mismatch, or a record whose preregistration or runner digest differs

secondary_verdict_B.CGC_ADDS_OVER_SMALLER_FFN: A_BETTER against B on code and on prose

analysis.factorial: secondary and descriptive: the same classes for A0 against C0 and B0; interaction per seed and domain = (bpb(C) - bpb(A)) - (bpb(C0) - bpb(A0)); no qualification decision
analysis.reliance_D: per seed and mean bpb(D) - bpb(A); descriptive

interval.use: reported for transparency; with three seeds it decides nothing

analysis.latency_use: measured decode latency of A over C above 1.10 is reported as a material latency cost of CGC; it does not change the quality classes

r7_reproduction.protocol: R7 as executed: run_r7.study_model('ple', 0) trained by run_r7._train for a configured 1,500 steps, which ends after one epoch (1,432 steps)
r7_reproduction.use: pipeline integrity only; a FAIL is reported and investigated, it does not enter the verdict

integrity.construction_identity: build('A', seed) must equal run_r7.study_model('ple', seed) parameter by parameter at initialization

secondary_endpoints: CGC gate values (16 per model) at every evaluation step
gradient norms by parameter group: training gradients (after clipping) at every evaluation step, and one held-out batch at the end
routing on held-out batches: per-block channel shares, maximum over mean, coefficient of variation, router entropy, inactive channels
training stability: status, loss at every evaluation step
free-running generation mechanics: greedy continuation of fixed held-out prompts
held-out bits/byte against cumulative training compute (3 x measured forward matmul FLOPs per token x 2,048 tokens per step)
quality per unit of measured cost

generation.prompts: the first held-out documents of each domain in corpus order

latency.weights: untrained (seed 0); the operation counts do not depend on weight values
latency.order: arms interleaved step by step with a rotating order

measurement_labels.EXACT: a formula or the nbytes of an allocated tensor
measurement_labels.MEASURED: counted or timed on this machine (FlopCounterMode matmul FLOPs, wall-clock, peak RSS)
measurement_labels.PROJECTED: derived from EXACT quantities and stated assumptions
measurement_labels.BOUND: an upper bound by construction (weights read per token = active parameters x bytes, with no reuse)

limits.order: integrity and the 12 primary training runs (seeds 0, 1, 2 of A, B, C, C_mac), then latency alone on an idle machine, then the 9 factorial runs, then combine

stopping_rules: no early stopping and no selection of steps: the endpoint is step 1,500
a run that diverges or exceeds its limit is recorded as such and is not repeated; its arm cannot qualify
no seeds are added, and no confirmatory run is repeated, after any outcome has been seen
delta_min, arms, widths, data, endpoints and classes do not change after this file is committed
whatever the verdict, no larger model is trained in R9 to change it
the factorial runs only after every primary run has finished and only within the secondary budget

accounted_configurations: the R9 study arms (d 64): no history head, state independent of context
the R8 timing geometry enc256 (d 256, 4 ERSA blocks, 8 experts top-2 in blocks 1 and 3, PLE before block 1, R5 head with a 256-wide encoder) with fine_keys reread and stored, PLE on and off
the R6 scale configurations r6_500m and r6_1b on the meta device
p3.measured_configuration: the R8 timing geometry enc256 at capacity 1,048,576, untrained, float32, 4 threads, decode p50/p95 at each length, R5 off / reread / stored, PLE on and off

ddr3_scenario.status: ASSUMED platform; not a property of this execution environment

p3.target_use: a future performance target; compared against projections, never claimed

retrieval_quality_metric.definition: exact-answer accuracy at answer positions (argmax over the value vocabulary equals the gold value) on held-out R5 streams, per case, with recall@64 (coarse) and recall@4 (fine) of the gold evidence block; labels are used for scoring only

cases.latest_binding: records family, keys revised 1-3 times, direct ASK questions
cases.revision_sensitive: the same probes scored separately where superseded binds or stale questions are present
cases.contradiction: probes whose key has a negated bind (NOT KEY_k VAL_x) in context
cases.provenance: scoped family: GET SCOPE_s SYM_x with wrong-scope declarations in context

retrieval_quality_metric.status: NOT_RUN in R9: no model trained for retrieval exists in R9's scope (the study arms have no history head; R5's trained models are not retained as checkpoints), and training one is outside R9's priority order. R5's own result stands as the reference: it did not solve autonomous recall.
